verses.english: Sets of Eleven on Training, Etc.

verses.pali: “Jarāmaraṇaṁ, bhikkhave, ajānatā apassatā yathābhūtaṁ jarāmaraṇe yathābhūtaṁ ñāṇāya sikkhā karaṇīyā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, one who does not truly know or see old age and death should train so as to truly know old age and death. …”
